page.overview:
Who is Councilor Tuva?

She is a low-ranking member of the Coalition of Planets.

Councilor Tuva is a tall humanoid woman with long dark hair. She has light green skin, and wears a sleek uniform that is green and black, accompanied by green earrings and black shoes.

Little is known about Tuva personality, but she gives the impression of being a kind woman who tries to do her job well. Her professionalism is evident when she votes alongside the other crew members to replace the incompetent Captain Pikell with General Telia.

She also appears to be easily startled, as she screams in fright on the two occasions a fire breaks out in the Venture's control panels.
